recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. If Clinical Genomics wants additional diagnostic-module use cases, handle that as a separate WG-authored Jira/PR with approved text rather than expanding FHIR-50672 beyond its imaging Confluence resolution.
issue_request: FHIR-50672 is an Applied/Persuasive with Modification R6 change request asking for Diagnostics module use cases beyond the existing detailed laboratory material, with imaging and genomics named as examples. The final resolution approved adding the content from the Imaging Integration Confluence page as a new section.
initial_application: The issue was applied by HL7/fhir#3871. Commit 335e930873f9034b9018b43ac5a222c1d44830c0 added an Imaging subsection to source/diagnostics-module.html under Organizing Related DiagnosticReport and Observation Resources; the merged PR also carried diagnostic-module-imaging figure assets and publish.ini entries for those images.
additional_context: The approved Confluence page is specifically an Imaging Integration update and contains the DICOM SR-to-FHIR Observation text and example imaging use cases that now appear in source. OO and Imaging Integration Confluence pages reference FHIR-50672 with Diagnostic Module diagrams/updates. The combined branch also links the Diagnostics module from source/hierarchy.xml and source/modules-fragment.html, while genomics is already represented by the separate Genomics Implementation Guidance pointer and GenomicStudy/MolecularDefinition references. Because the final resolution supplied imaging content only, adding new genomics use-case prose would go beyond the voted text.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The combined-branch source already contains the approved imaging section and image references in build scope, and no prior Issue-Reconcile-Key: FHIR-50672 commit was present before this audit commit.
